model: BusWorks XT1121-000 16-channel sourcing digital I/O (Modbus TCP)
applies_to: BusWorks XT1121-000 per user's manual 8500950P (revision P, 18 Nov 2022).
summary: The Acromag BusWorks XT1121-000 is a Modbus TCP Ethernet module with 16 active-high inputs paired with 16 high-side (sourcing) outputs. Its Modbus map is I/O only: four input-state words, a heartbeat counter and four output-command words; all setup is done over USB.

addressing.note: The register map prints both the reference (30001, 40001) and the 0-based address column (0, 1, 2...); the address column is what goes on the wire.

source.title: BusWorks XT Series Model XT1121-000 16-Channel Sourcing Digital I/O User's Manual

notes: Each group word covers four channels in bits 0-3; bits 4-15 are unused and read 0.
Input words show the real level at each channel, so they also read back the state of the paired output.
There are no configuration registers: IP settings, input invert and watchdog are set only with the USB configuration software.
The manual's revision table lists 8500950P as released 18 Nov 2022; the download URL path still carries a 2019 date.

registers.name: Input State Group 0 (CH0-3)
registers.description: Input states, bit 0 = lowest channel; 1 = high (no invert).

registers.name: Input State Group 1 (CH4-7)
registers.description: Input states, bit 0 = lowest channel; 1 = high (no invert).

registers.name: Input State Group 2 (CH8-11)
registers.description: Input states, bit 0 = lowest channel; 1 = high (no invert).

registers.name: Input State Group 3 (CH12-15)
registers.description: Input states, bit 0 = lowest channel; 1 = high (no invert).

registers.name: Heart Beat
registers.description: Counter that rises by 1 per transfer and wraps at 65535.

registers.name: Set Output State Group 0 (CH0-3)
registers.description: Output commands, bit 0 = lowest channel; 1 = on (sourcing).

registers.name: Set Output State Group 1 (CH4-7)
registers.description: Output commands, bit 0 = lowest channel; 1 = on (sourcing).

registers.name: Set Output State Group 2 (CH8-11)
registers.description: Output commands, bit 0 = lowest channel; 1 = on (sourcing).

registers.name: Set Output State Group 3 (CH12-15)
registers.description: Output commands, bit 0 = lowest channel; 1 = on (sourcing).

integration.summary: Read input registers 0-3 for input states and write holding registers 0-3 to drive the outputs, four channels per word. Watch input register 4 to confirm the module is updating.
integration.enable: Modbus TCP needs no enabling; set the IP address (default static 192.168.1.100) with the USB configuration software before connecting to the network. The manual does not print the TCP port number.
integration.watchdog: Per-channel watchdog (5-65534 s, 0 or 65535 = off) set in the USB software: with no read/write activity for that time the output goes to its chosen watchdog state and stays there until written again.
quirks: Output commands are lost at reset (outputs start OFF); they are not kept in flash.
The Unit ID is ignored and echoed back.
setup: Configure IP address, input invert and watchdog over USB before connecting to the network.
Outputs need 6-32 V excitation on EXC to work.
gotchas: If an output is on, the paired input reads high: turn the output off to monitor a field signal on that channel.

verified.method: independent re-check of every register against the source PDF
